## Core Services
- [All Services](https://sillymedia.in/services): Overview of all five digital engineering services.
- [Custom Website Development in Delhi NCR](https://sillymedia.in/services/custom-websites): Pre-rendered Next.js & headless websites built in 14–21 working days.
- [Hyperlocal SEO & Google Maps Ranking](https://sillymedia.in/services/local-seo-google-maps): Google Business Profile optimization, local Schema.org, and neighbourhood SEO.
- [WhatsApp Business Automation](https://sillymedia.in/services/whatsapp-automation): Official Meta Cloud API appointment booking, lead qualification, and CRM sync.
- [Web Apps & SaaS MVPs](https://sillymedia.in/services/web-apps-saas): Full-stack TypeScript, Next.js, and PostgreSQL MVPs delivered in 4–6 weeks.
- [Custom AI Chatbots & Agents](https://sillymedia.in/services/ai-chatbots-agents): Guardrailed multilingual (English/Hindi/Hinglish) assistants and document workflows.
